modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On November 5, 2024: Donald Trump becomes the first president of the United States to be elected to a non-consecutive second term in 132 years, since Grover Cleveland won the 1892 election.
On November 5, 2013: The Indian Space Research Organisation launched the Mars Orbiter Mission, India's first interplanetary probe.
On November 5, 2007: China's first lunar satellite, Chang'e 1, goes into orbit around the Moon.
On November 5, 1986: USS Rentz, USS Reeves and USS Oldendorf visit Qingdao, China; the first US naval visit to China since 1949.
On November 5, 1895: George B. Selden is granted the first U.S. patent for an automobile.
